Nina (CS): OrchardPay weekly health check — need a short ops summary for renewal prep. Key numbers: tokens ~1.5M (+4% w/w), avg batch size 4.2, cache hit 22% (down 2pp), cost per 1k tokens $1.80 (+5%), p95 latency up to 480ms (from 360ms). Any quick hypotheses?
Theo (Infra): Noticed traffic pattern shift: bursty batched sends around 14:05 UTC with lots of long prompts. That forces model selector to fall back to the larger variant for ~6% of requests. Fallback explains a chunk of p95 and cost.
Marco (SRE): We also saw a small increase in cache evictions (LRU churn) overnight ~9%. Likely due to slightly larger sessions plus new user cohort. That would depress hit rate.
Asha (PM): Renewal is in 11 days. If we can present a plan that shows hit recovery and a cap on p95 exposure, that's ideal. Can we get a conservative cost improvement estimate?
Nina (CS): Also: customer reported a small number of aborted requests on mobile (they called it ~30/day). Could be related to the fallbacks/timeouts.
Theo (Infra): Quick mitigations I'm proposing: (1) merge window increase from 30ms -> 70ms to pull more concurrent small requests into the same batch; (2) temporarily pin routing for high-latency flows to the standard model to avoid expensive fallbacks; (3) enlarge in-memory prefix cache by +15%.
Marco (SRE): Caveat: increasing merge window can slightly raise tail latencies in cold pods. I'll gate merge-window increase with a CPU-utilization check so it only applies when node load < 65%. Also will warm new prefix entries during off-peak.
Theo (Infra): Deploy fragment (small change):
```
orchardpay.service.batching:
  merge_window_ms: 70
  max_batch: 20
  cpu_gate_pct: 65
orchardpay.cache:
  in_memory_prefix_limit_pct: 115
  warm_window_utc: "02:00-04:00"
```
billing-bot: Monthly spend alert: OrchardPay projected run-rate $25.2k (prior month $24.1k).
Asha (PM): Theo — do you have an estimate on cost/1k tokens if hit rate recovers +4pp and avg batch climbs to 5.5? We need a slide-friendly number.
Theo (Infra): Rough ballpark: current $1.80/1k. With +4pp hit and batch ->5.5, expect ~-12% cost => ~$1.58/1k tokens. That's conservative.
Marco (SRE): Risk note: merge-window increase could add ~10-30ms to p95 on cold starts; CPU gating should mitigate. I'll add an alert: p95 > +50ms or error rate +0.5% triggers rollback.
Nina (CS): OK. I'll craft the one-slide summary: numbers, planned ops changes, risk windows, and owner list. @Theo @Marco please drop 2-line ops blurbs for the slide.
Theo (Infra): Ops blurb: increasing merge window + prefix cache bump to recover reuse; routing pins for long sequences to avoid expensive fallbacks. PR will be opened w/ feature flag.
Marco (SRE): Ops blurb: gating merge-window by CPU, warming prefixes off-peak, alert/rollback thresholds set in runbook. Runbook draft: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/orchardpay-cache-batching
Nina (CS): Thanks. Action items: (1) Theo deploy feature-flagged change and post PR link; (2) Marco add monitoring alert and warm job; (3) Nina finalize slide and send to Asha by EOD.
Theo (Infra): Will open PR now and target a canary deploy in 2 hours.
Marco (SRE): Warm job scheduled for 02:15 UTC tomorrow.
Nina (CS): Great — will follow up after canary. :thumbsup:
